subject: Startups
title: Activation Rate
description: A quick win: understand Activation Rate.

hook.text: Signing up isn't the same as getting value. Activation rate measures how many sign-ups actually start using the product.

buildup.text: The 'aha moment' is when a user first experiences value. For Facebook, it was adding 7 friends in 10 days.

discovery.text: Slack found that teams exchanging 2,000 messages had a 93% chance of becoming long-term paying customers.

twist.text: A startup with 100K sign-ups and 5% activation is worse off than one with 10K sign-ups and 50% activation.

climax.text: Fixing activation is often the highest-leverage growth move. More users reaching 'aha' means more paying customers.

punchline.text: Sign-ups don't pay bills. Activated users do.
